×

Badge/Number

Unread count badge. One to three digits and overflow fold in.
×

BottomAppBar/Standard

Screen-level actions along the bottom. FAB and action count fold in.
×

Button/Filled

Highest emphasis; the primary action. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

Button/Tonal

Secondary, still prominent. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

Button/Outlined

Medium emphasis on a busy surface. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

Button/Elevated

Outlined alternative needing separation. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

Button/Text

Lowest emphasis; inline actions. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants. The container is transparent, so the shape axis is invisible at rest — the kit draws its square nodes the same way, and `square-hovered` is the cell where it shows.
×

Card/Filled

Default container for related content, with media and text by default. The kit's empty slot layout and the action layouts fold in.
×

Card/Elevated

Separated by shadow, with media and text by default. The kit's empty slot layout and the action layouts fold in.
×

Card/Outlined

Separated by outline, with media and text by default. The kit's empty slot layout and the action layouts fold in.
×

Carousel/MultiBrowse

Items that resize as they enter and leave the viewport. Item widths fold in.
×

Checkbox/Checked

Select one or more items from a set. Unchecked, indeterminate, disabled and error fold in.
×

Chip/Assist

A smart action related to the content. Elevated, leading icon and disabled fold in.
×

Chip/Filter

Filters content; carries a selected state. Unselected, elevated and disabled fold in. The check mark is the selected state's leading icon, so it follows selection rather than a knob.
×

Chip/Input

A discrete piece of user input, removable. Leading icon, avatar, selected and disabled fold in.
×

Chip/Suggestion

A dynamically generated action. Elevated and disabled fold in; the kit's selected cells stay excluded because SuggestionChip has no selection state.
×

Color/Role grid

Material color roles in the kit's schematic layout — accent families, fixed colors and surfaces — with all six catalog themes as variants.
×

DatePicker/Modal

The picker on its own dialog surface, with confirm and dismiss actions.
×

Dialog/Basic

Headline, supporting text and two actions. The hero icon folds in.
×

Dialog/List

A choice list in place of supporting text.
×

Divider/Horizontal

Separates content in a vertical list. Inset and subhead fold in.
×

Divider/Vertical

Separates content in a horizontal row.
×

Fab/Standard

The screen's single primary action. Six container roles fold in as variants.
×

Fab/Extended

FAB with a label; the action is named. Six container roles fold in as variants.
×

IconButton/Standard

Lowest emphasis; inline on a surface. Five sizes x three widths x two shapes fold in as variants. The container is transparent, so the shape axis is invisible at rest — the kit draws its square nodes the same way, and `square-hovered` is the cell where it shows.
×

IconButton/Filled

Highest emphasis icon-only action. Five sizes x three widths x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

IconButton/Tonal

Secondary emphasis. Five sizes x three widths x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

IconButton/Outlined

Medium emphasis on a busy surface. Five sizes x three widths x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

List/Item

The kit's list frame. Line count, leading and trailing slots all fold in as single rows.
×

LoadingIndicator/Uncontained

The shape-morph indicator on its own.
×

NavigationBar/Short

The expressive compact bar. Count and labels fold in.
×

NavigationRail/Standard

Destinations along the side. Count, menu, FAB and labels fold in.
×

NavigationRail/Wide

The expanded form, labels beside the icons. Count folds in.
×

Progress/Linear

Determinate linear progress. Values across the range fold in.
×

Progress/Circular

Determinate circular progress. Values across the range fold in.
×

RadioButton/Selected

Select exactly one option from a set. Unselected, disabled and error fold in.
×

Search/Bar

The collapsed entry point, floating over content. Query, avatar and the docked form fold in.
×

SegmentedButton/SingleChoice

Two to five related options. Count, content and multi-select fold in.
×

Shape/Corner scale

The Material corner scale, with each of its ten radius tokens folded in as a variant.
×

Shape/MaterialShapes

The expressive shape library. All 35 of `MaterialShapes` fold in as variants.
×

Slider/Continuous

Select a value from a range. Discrete stops, a centered track and disabled fold in.
×

Slider/Range

Two thumbs bounding a sub-range. Discrete stops and disabled fold in.
×

Snackbar/Message

Brief message about a process. Two-line, action and close affordance fold in.
×

SplitButton/Filled

Primary action plus a related-choices affordance. Five sizes and four colours fold in.
×

Switch/On

Toggle a single setting on or off. Off, thumb icon and disabled fold in.
×

Tabs/Primary

Top-level content categories under an app bar. Icon and icon+label fold in.
×

Tabs/Secondary

Nested categories within a primary tab. Icon and icon+label fold in.
×

TextField/Filled

The default; a filled container. Empty, error, disabled, icons, supporting text and the label-less form fold in.
×

TextField/Outlined

Outlined container; less visual weight. Carries the same matrix as the filled field.
×

TimePicker/Dial

Clock dial for picking an hour and minute. 12-hour and the landscape layout fold in.
×

TimePicker/Input

Keyboard entry instead of the dial. 12-hour folds in.
×

ToggleButton/Filled

A button whose selection persists. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

ToggleButton/Tonal

Secondary emphasis toggle. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

ToggleButton/Outlined

Medium emphasis on a busy surface. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

ToggleButton/Elevated

Separated by shadow. Five sizes x two shapes fold in as variants.
×

Toolbar/HorizontalFloating

A floating cluster of related actions over the content. Vibrant folds in.
×

TopAppBar/Small

The app bar. Its four sizes, centred, image and search layouts, nav icon and actions fold in.
×

Typography/Type scale

The Material 3 type scale, with each of its fifteen roles folded in as a variant.
